title: RC-10 sibling sites in the exit engine: wait() with no timeout runs inside the wallet nonce lock at six exit sites, and a never-settling wait also pins the per-token sell lock

evidence.note: public-fallback approve: withNonceLock(... await approveTx.wait()) (named in ESC-PRE-02 as :545)
public-fallback swap: withNonceLock(... await stx.wait()) (named in ESC-PRE-02 as :556)
ensureApproval: await approveTx.wait() with no timeout; it runs inside withNonceLock at four more sites not named in ESC-PRE-02: :871 (V3 full), :874 (V2 full), :1509 (V3 partial), :1512 (V2 partial)
wait() timeout defaults to 0; the timer is only armed when timeout > 0 (:1172-1178), so it waits forever for a tx that is never mined
withNonceLock chains each op after the prior settles, so a never-settling op blocks every later signing op for the wallet

releaseSellLock runs only in executeFullSell finally; a wait that never settles never reaches it, so the per-token sell lock stays held and every later exit of that token (anti-rug and dashboard included) returns "Another exit already handling" (:832-835)
the worker watchdog frees the drain loop after the budget but does not settle the inner op, so both locks stay held
withTimeout (used by the anti-rug exit, exitTrigger.ts:265-269) likewise frees only the caller
codex (22-27 independent second opinion, graded S1): Watchdog expiry leaves the underlying sell lock held

sibling_sites_checked: Every wait( in the slice: :422 (ensureApproval, reached under the lock from :871, :874, :1509, :1512), :545, :556. No other .wait( in exitManager.ts, exitWatchdog.ts or withTimeout.ts. This entry belongs to the never-settling-operation mechanism of RC-10 (a wait with no timeout inside withNonceLock), not to the nested-lock re-entrancy mechanism; the TX slice (22-20) owns RC-10 and defines both sub-findings, so related carries the rc:RC-10 placeholder until 22-28 replaces it with the TX never-settling sub-finding id. The BUY-slice rediscovery of the same mechanism is AUD-BUY-025 (bot.ts:750).
severity_rationale: S1, equal to the research suggestion and to ESC-PRE-02. Registered from the EXIT slice because the sites are in this slice. It is a rediscovery, so it links the existing pre-phase record and is not escalated again. New relative to ESC-PRE-02: four further sites through ensureApproval (:871, :874, :1509, :1512), and the sell-lock pinning, which blocks even the direct anti-rug exit of that token.
recommendation: Covered by the RC-10 fix planned for Phase 24 in the TX slice (bounded wait, or no wait inside the lock, plus releasing the sell lock when an exit is abandoned); apply it to all six exit sites.
